payload.purpose_context: When two approved lanes conflict, consolidate currently tells operators to resolve and commit on the lane, then refuses that commit as unreviewed content; the rollback also erases the state the advice refers to. This mission names and makes executable the sanctioned route (re-review and re-approval of the resolution), refuses unreviewed resolutions early with a clear message, closes related soundness gaps, and keeps unreviewed content from ever landing.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make consolidate's stale-lane advice and its reconciliation gate agree on how a conflict between approved lanes is resolved, so operators get one working, reviewed route instead of advice that leads into a refusal.

payload.question: Confirm the Intent Summary and extracted FR/NFR/C set for the approved-lane conflict resolution route Mission (#5604 scope per operator ruling 2026-11-20), including two plan-level defaults: (a) the stale remedy names the sibling lane(s) and halt reason rather than keeping an in-run mission-tip ref; (b) #7767 is fixed by undoing this run's own auto-rebase merges on lanes under compare-and-swap at rollback.

payload.final_answer: Confirm as written (operator, 2026-11-20): intent summary, FR-001..FR-013, N1-N4, NFRs, constraints, and defaults (a) sibling lane + halt reason, (b) CAS undo of the run's own auto-rebase merges at rollback.

options: (b) Extend the canonical lane sync point: spec-kitty agent action implement <WP> --incorporate <lane> merges the sibling lane approval stamp into the lane checkout and stops on a conflict for hand resolution (recommended; keeps A-10)

payload.question: FR-001: the re-review route must incorporate the SIBLING lane (at its approval-stamp SHA) into the stale approved lane, because rollback restored the Mission branch. No CLI command does that today, and the #7285 A-10 rule (pinned by tests/lanes/test_stale_remediation_cli_command.py:76-96) forbids raw 'git merge' / 'cd .worktrees' recipes in the remedy. Which route?

payload.final_answer: (b) Extend the canonical sync point: spec-kitty agent action implement <WP> --mission <m> --incorporate <lane> merges the sibling lane approval-stamp SHA into the lane checkout and stops on a conflict for hand resolution.
